context.transcript:
Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
Thank you for joining us at the Jamestown Concert Hall.
I am pleased to introduce Jin-ho Shin, who is giving his first piano concert here in Jamestown tonight.
Mr. Shin's career is interesting because he's traveled almost non-stop for the past several years. in the last year alone he has performed in over 60 cities in 20 different countries before he takes the stage I'd like to remind you to turn off your mobile phones to prevent interruptions during the performance
context.transcript_translation:
女士们先生们，大家晚上好。
感谢您来到詹姆斯敦音乐厅参加我们的活动。
我很高兴地介绍金浩申（Jin-ho Shin），他今晚在这里首次举办钢琴音乐会。
申先生的职业生涯很有趣，因为在过去的几年里，他几乎不间断地旅行。仅去年一年，他就曾在 20 个不同国家、超过 60 个城市演出过。在我上台之前，我想提醒大家请关闭手机，以避免影响表演。
